vetSays.line: 📋 A person, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek wants to know what's by the creek. "Just look. Come back and tell me."
A person, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A person, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +2 clean.
📋 A person, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek — 🪾 Gather deadfall. They'll report back by next part.
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
You were listening. Now you know Ground Elder too.

🛡️ Jaxon, Chen, the person in their 60s, with a slouched posture, Khe and the woman in her 30s, with weathered hands, the physical therapy aide met them at the door — 5 put down. Jaxon, Chen, the person in their 60s, with a slouched posture, the woman in her 30s, with weathered hands, the physical therapy aide are hurt.
🌿 Ground Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 Ground Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🌿 Ground Elder, weeks in the baskets. Handling it day after day, the village has learned what it's FOR — not just what it is. The village knows its uses now.
💡 Ground Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/2) and it'll click.
🛡️ Jaxon, Felipe and Chen met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 barely walked away. Felipe, Chen are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jaxon just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ishaan just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Jaxon, Chen, Ishaan, Ivy and Lena met them at the door — 5 put down. Jaxon, Chen, Ivy, Lena are hurt.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
✨ Ability gained: Cold-Blooded (L1). You need 20% less food in cold weather. Your body budgets like an accountant.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Joseph just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Joseph, Priya and Ines met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 barely walked away. Joseph, Priya, Ines are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ines just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Joseph just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Priya met them at the door — 1 put down. Priya is hurt.
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
Blooded — the village knows where the Producers bleed. (Strikes hit 1.5× as hard; their blows land at 0.75× strength.)

regDeaths.name: the creek went still, and your arm-hairs stood up
two knobs on glass-still water, watching
a red moon rising between the trees, breathing
a soft green glow under the water
a boulder with opinions about where you're walking
